arxiv-2005-04796.title: Metabolic heat in microbial conflict and cooperation
arxiv-2005-04796.description: Abstract Metabolic heat in microbial conflict and cooperation Steven A. Frank * * footnotemark: * Many microbes live in habitats below their optimum temperature. Retention of metabolic heat by aggregation or insulation would boost growth. Generation of excess metabolic heat may also provide benefit.

arxiv-2112-01718.title: Improving Predictions of Tail-end Labels using Concatenated BioMed-Transformers for Long Medical Documents
arxiv-2112-01718.creator: Vithya Yogarajan, Bernhard Pfahringer, Tony Smith, Jacob Montiel
arxiv-2112-01718.description: Abstract Multi-label learning predicts a subset of labels from a given label set for an unseen instance while considering label correlations. A known challenge with multi-label classification is the long-tailed distribution of labels. Many studies focus on improving the overall predictions of the model and thus do not prioritise tail-end labels.

arxiv-2204-13346.title: UniTE: Unified Translation Evaluation
arxiv-2204-13346.creator: Yu Wan Dayiheng Liu Baosong Yang Haibo Zhang Boxing Chen, Derek F. Wong Lidia S. Chao
arxiv-2204-13346.description: Abstract Translation quality evaluation plays a crucial role in machine translation. According to the input format, it is mainly separated into three tasks, i.e. , reference-only, source-only and source-reference-combined. Recent methods, despite their promising results, are specifically designed and optimized on one of them. This limits the convenience of these methods, and overlooks the commonalities among tasks.

arxiv-2406-12136.title: Integrating 2D Magnets for Quantum Devices: from Materials and Characterization to Future Technology
arxiv-2406-12136.creator: Han Zhong, Douglas Z. Plummer, Pengcheng Lu, Yang Li, Polina A. Leger, Yingying Wu
arxiv-2406-12136.description: Abstract The unveiling of 2D van der Waals magnetism in 2017 ignited a surge of interest in low-dimensional magnetism. With dimensions reduced, research has delved into facile electric control of 2D magnetism, high-quality heterostructure design, and new device functionality. These atomically thin magnetic materials have spawned a burgeoning field known as 2D spintronics, holding immense promise for future quantum technologies.

arxiv-2410-10184.title: Eliminating the Language Bias for Visual Question Answering with fine-grained Causal Intervention Thanks: ∗ The first three authors contribute equally.
arxiv-2410-10184.creator: Ying Liu*, Ge Bai*, Chenji Lu*, Shilong Li, Zhang Zhang, Ruifang Liu and Wenbin Guo 🖂
arxiv-2410-10184.description: Abstract Despite the remarkable advancements in Visual Question Answering (VQA), the challenge of mitigating the language bias introduced by textual information remains unresolved. Previous approaches capture language bias from a coarse-grained perspective. However, the finer-grained information within a sentence, such as context and keywords, can result in different biases.

pmc-11496834.title: Bioinformatic insights into sugar signaling pathways in sugarcane growth
pmc-11496834.creator: Lauana Pereira de Oliveira, João Pedro de Jesus Pereira, Bruno Viana Navarro, Marina C. M. Martins, Diego Mauricio Riaño-Pachón, Marcos Silveira Buckeridge
pmc-11496834.description: The SnRK1, hexokinase, and TORC1 (TOR, LST8, RAPTOR) are three pivotal kinases at the core of sugar level sensing, significantly impacting plant metabolism and development. We retrieved and analyzed protein sequences of these three kinase pathways from seven sugarcane transcriptome and genome datasets, identifying protein domains, phylogenetic relationships, sequence ancestry, and in silico expression levels.

pmc-11685223.title: Lactate dehydrogenase to albumin ratio (LAR) is a novel predictor of fatal outcome in patients with SFTS: an observational study
pmc-11685223.creator: Tao Meng, Wenqian Ding, Dongmei Lv, Chenxu Wang, Yuanhong Xu
pmc-11685223.description: BackgroundSevere fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS) is a serious infectious disease. This study explored the prognostic value of lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) to albumin (ALB) ratio (LAR) levels in fatal outcomes of the disease.MethodsTwo-hundred and nine patients with SFTS were enrolled in this study. Based on the prognosis, patients were divided into survival and deceased groups.

pmc-11709909.title: The role of TGFbeta signals in Lead (Pb)‐induced Cerebral Amyloid Angiopathy
pmc-11709909.creator: Huiying Gu, Alexandria Luo, Wei Zheng, Yansheng Du
pmc-11709909.description: BackgroundMounting evidence suggests that acute and past exposure to the environmental toxicant lead (Pb) results in longitudinal decline in cognitive function and brain atrophy. In animals, chronic Pb exposure can increase brain Aβ deposition. However, it remains unclear how Pb induces different natures of amyloid depositions and underlying mechanisms to contribute to the pathogenesis of AD and related dementia.

pmc-12495700.title: Association between periodontitis and breast cancer in Indian women – a pilot study in Dakshina Kannada, Karnataka
pmc-12495700.creator: Aparna K S, Avinash B R, Rajesh Gururaghavendran
pmc-12495700.description: BackgroundThe most prevalent cancer in women is breast cancer (BC), and its prevalence is on the rise in India. Chronic inflammatory diseases like periodontitis have been connected to the development of cancer and systemic inflammation. This study aimed to assess the relationship between periodontitis and breast cancer in Indian women.

pmc-13344104.title: Contemporary achievement of guideline recommendations for blood pressure management after stroke in the CONVINCE trial
pmc-13344104.creator: Pádraig Synnott, Cathal Walsh, Christian Weimar, Francisco Purroy, Chris Price, Ana Catarina Fonseca, Michael Hill, Dalius Jatuzis, Janika Kõrv, Christina Kruuse, Robert Mikulik, Paul Nederkoorn, Anna Czlonkowska, Urs Fischer, Darius G Nabavi, Joseph Harbison, Tim Cassidy, Margaret O’Connor, Helle K
pmc-13344104.description: IntroductionHypertension is a major modifiable risk factor for stroke. Studies between 1996 and 2013 reported high rates of non-achievement of guideline recommended blood pressure (BP) targets following stroke/TIA. Few recent large studies of long-term post-stroke BP management exist, and no studies have reported findings since the introduction of new guideline recommendations (systolic blood pressure [SBP] < 130 mmHg) in 2022.

pmc-13381745.title: Direct measurement of Criegee intermediates in isoprene ozonolysis
pmc-13381745.creator: Lei Yang, Katia Hatem, Mixtli Campos-Pineda, Jingsong Zhang
pmc-13381745.description: Isoprene is the most abundant unsaturated hydrocarbon in the troposphere. Carbonyl oxides, also called Criegee intermediates, are highly reactive transient species in the ozonolysis of alkenes that play important roles in tropospheric oxidation. Despite decades of efforts, direct observation of Criegee intermediates in isoprene ozonolysis has not been achieved.

pmc-13535256.title: Hiding in plain sight: uncovering the genetic basis of complex phenotypes through low-risk groups
pmc-13535256.creator: Ana I Vazquez, Yifei Li, Guanqi Lu, Harish Neelam, Molly S Bray, Sadeep Shrestha, Richard J Reynolds, Hongsheng Gui, Davorka Gulisija
pmc-13535256.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Medical genetic studies focus on high-risk groups to enrich for targeted phenotypes. Although genetic effects may vary across the lifespan, age-related enrichment of target phenotypes can also arise from cumulative environmental exposures, without requiring changes in genetic architecture. Accumulating environmental effects over the lifetime can inflate nongenetic variance, creating the illusion of greater genetic signal while in fact masking underlying genetic effects.

pmc-13586993.title: Effect of RISCO–NUTRIFOUR Probiotic on Growth and Carcass Traits in Broilers During Starter and Grower Phases
pmc-13586993.creator: Abdulaziz A. Al‐abdullatif, Maged A. Al‐Garadi, Mohammed M. Qaid, Abdulkareem M. Matar, Mohammed Al‐Badwi, Mohsen M. Alobre, Gamaleldin M. Suliman, Elsayed O. Hussein
pmc-13586993.description: The growing concern over antibiotic resistance has prompted the exploration of probiotics as sustainable alternatives in poultry production. This study evaluated the effects of a multi‐strain, multi‐genera probiotic supplement (RISCO‐NUTRIFOUR solution (RNFS), administered via drinking water (Days 1–14) and feed (Days 15–28)) on broiler performance and carcass characteristics over a 28‐day period.

pmc-13610573.title: Spatial distribution of marker compounds in Epimedium sagittatum leaves and the role of UGT72B113 in generating kaempferol glycoside diversity
pmc-13610573.creator: Bin Yan, Xinghao Zhang, Ziyan Xie, Huanhuan Liang, Yongxia Jia, Hanxiang Li, Yuping Li, Yongqing Li, Junjie Wei, Ying Wang, Xiaoman Yang
pmc-13610573.description: Epimedium sagittatum is an important medicinal plant whose main bioactive flavonol glycosides, such as epimedin C and icariin, are derived from kaempferol. However, the spatial distribution of these compounds within the plant and the genetic basis for their structural diversity remain unclear. Here, we employed MALDI-TOF mass spectrometry imaging to visualize the distribution of epimedin C and icariin in E.
